items.title: Solana Will Now Print Less SOL as Disinflation Vote Passes in Dramatic Fashion
items.whyYouShouldCare: The recent disinflation vote will reduce the supply of SOL, potentially increasing its value and enhancing scarcity in the ecosystem.

items.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
items.whyYouShouldCare: The close vote to double disinflation reflects strong community engagement and could influence future governance decisions impacting Solana's economic model.

items.title: Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM
items.whyYouShouldCare: The Bitwise fund reaching $1 billion AUM signifies growing institutional interest in Solana, which could boost liquidity and ecosystem development.
